close_reason: ci.yml conformance job (ubuntu+macos): submodule checkout, build/pb cached on OS+arch+submodule commit+build_runner.sh hash, build_runner.sh only on cache miss, stdio spike driver (macOS too, per gpb-wof.3 note), run_conformance.sh --maximum_edition 2023, check_testee.py, test_run_conformance.sh. title: Build golden-test harness
description: scripts/golden.sh: for each tests/protos/*.proto, run protoc with the plugin into a temp dir, diff against tests/golden/, then 'goose check' each generated file. Goose has no formatter, so also run generation twice and require byte-identical output. --update rewrites goldens.
acceptance_criteria: Harness passes on the empty-output skeleton; a deliberately changed golden makes it fail with a readable diff; a non-typechecking golden makes it fail; --update regenerates; documented in AGENTS.md.
close_reason: scripts/golden.sh: per tests/protos/*.proto, runs plugin twice (byte-identical required), diffs vs tests/golden/<name>/, goose checks each golden .goose beside runtime/pb_wire.goose; --update regenerates. Passes on skeleton. scripts/test_golden.sh (fake plugin) demonstrates changed-golden diff, non-typechecking golden, nondeterminism and --update. Documented in AGENTS.md.

title: Add Goose unit-test runner script
description: No 'goose test' exists. scripts/goose_tests.sh builds and runs every tests/**/*_test.goose with --debug; a test fails by aborting or returning nonzero.
acceptance_criteria: One passing and one failing sample test demonstrate the reporting; script exits nonzero on any failure and prints the failing file; used by CI.
close_reason: scripts/goose_tests.sh builds (--debug) and runs every *_test.goose under tests/ (or given paths); reports PASS/FAIL per file with output, exits nonzero on any failure. Fixtures in scripts/testdata/goose_tests (pass, abort, exit, debug overflow, build error) + scripts/test_goose_tests.sh demonstrate reporting. CI hookup is gpb-iip.8 (next).

title: Write hand-written Goose testee
description: conformance/testee.goose: loop reading 4-byte LE length + ConformanceRequest using the mechanism from the stdio spike; hand-parse just enough of ConformanceRequest (message_type field 4, payload oneof field 1 protobuf_payload, requested_output_format field 3) to reply: FailureSet (empty) for message_type == "conformance.FailureSet", 'skipped' (ConformanceResponse field 5) for everything not binary-in/binary-out, and for now 'skipped' for binary too.
acceptance_criteria: goose build conformance/testee.goose produces a binary; conformance_test_runner runs to completion against it with all tests reported skipped and exit status 0; no deadlock; exact-length reads verified with a frame split across writes.
notes: Mechanism decided in docs/decisions/0003-stdio.md: copy tests/spikes/stdio/stdio.c to conformance/io.c, add conformance/testee.build (c_sources = ["io.c"];), and reuse the echo.goose frame loop. Never use print/read_stdin/read_line in the testee.
close_reason: Testee built (conformance/testee.goose + io.c shim). conformance/check_testee.py passes for release, --debug and in-process builds, including a frame split mid-prefix with stdin open. Runner: binary_json 5649 skipped and text_format 909 skipped, 0 failures, exit 0 (--maximum_edition 2023).

title: Wire run_conformance.sh
description: scripts/run_conformance.sh (exists) runs the runner with --failure_list conformance/failure_list_goose.txt and the testee. Add a make-free entry point that builds the testee if needed, and pass-through for --maximum_edition, --enforce_recommended, --test.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/run_conformance.sh with no testee arg builds and runs the default testee; exit code is nonzero iff an unexpected failure or an unexpected pass occurs; usage documented in README.
close_reason: run_conformance.sh builds build/testee from conformance/testee.goose when missing/stale and no testee is given; runner flags pass through. Exit-code contract (unexpected fail/pass -> nonzero) verified by scripts/test_run_conformance.sh with a fake testee. README documents usage.

title: Add pinned toolchain install script
description: scripts/install_toolchain.sh installs protoc 36.2 and Goose v2026.3 for linux-x64, macos-arm64, macos-x64 into a given prefix (default .tools/), verifying sha256 sums recorded in the script. macOS: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine on the unpacked Goose dir. Usable both locally and in CI.
acceptance_criteria: Script is idempotent; .tools/bin/goose version and .tools/bin/protoc --version print the pinned versions on Linux (macOS verified in CI); checksum mismatch aborts; .tools/ is gitignored; TOOLCHAIN.md documents it.
close_reason: scripts/install_toolchain.sh installs protoc 36.2 + Goose v2026.3 (linux-x64, macos-arm64, macos-x64) into .tools/ with recorded sha256s. Verified on Linux: idempotent second run, versions print, tampered sha aborts with nothing installed. .tools/ gitignored; TOOLCHAIN.md documents it. macOS left to CI (gpb-iip.8).

description: scripts/build_runner.sh (exists, untested) builds conformance_test_runner from third_party/protobuf (v36.2) with CMake; abseil and jsoncpp come via FetchContent. Make it work on Linux and macOS and print the runner path.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh clone + 'git submodule update --init' + scripts/build_runner.sh produces build/pb/conformance_test_runner on Linux; '--help' style invocation prints usage; second run is incremental (< 30 s); build prerequisites listed in TOOLCHAIN.md.
close_reason: build_runner.sh builds build/pb/conformance_test_runner on Linux (fresh clone: 2m17s building protoc; with pinned protoc via WITH_PROTOC: 1m34s); runner prints usage; no-op rerun 0.05s; prerequisites in TOOLCHAIN.md. macOS covered by CI (gpb-iip.9).

title: Implement generator plugin skeleton
description: generator/src/main.zig: read all of stdin, decode CodeGeneratorRequest with zig-protobuf, write CodeGeneratorResponse{supported_features = FEATURE_PROTO3_OPTIONAL (1)} with no files. zig-protobuf v6.0.1 only exports the 'protobuf' module; its descriptor/plugin bindings import each other via '../', so regenerate them in build.zig with its RunProtocStep (or vendor them).
acceptance_criteria: zig build test passes; 'protoc --plugin=protoc-gen-goose=generator/zig-out/bin/protoc-gen-goose --goose_out=OUT tests/protos/smoke.proto' exits 0 and writes nothing; a malformed request makes the plugin exit nonzero with a message on stderr; smoke test is a script under tests/.
close_reason: Plugin decodes CodeGeneratorRequest, replies supported_features=1 with no files; bindings re-rooted via WriteFiles in build.zig. zig build test passes (2 tests); tests/smoke_plugin.sh passes (protoc 36.2 exit 0, empty out; malformed request exits 1 with stderr).

title: Spike: float/double to bits without a C shim
description: No public bit-cast builtin; 'x as u32' on a float truncates; stdlib binary has no float/u64 helpers. Candidate: bytes_of on an f32/f64 array (native-endian). Evaluate correctness (NaN payloads, -0.0, subnormals, inf) and portability (LE only?). Fallback: extern fn memcpy shim in runtime/pb_wire.c via a .build sidecar.
acceptance_criteria: Test program covers 0.0, -0.0, 1.0, inf, -inf, quiet/signalling NaN payloads, smallest subnormal, f32 and f64 both ways; docs/decisions/0002-float-bits.md picks pure Goose or the C shim, with the reason.
close_reason: Pure Goose wins: bytes_of (float->bits) + hand-built from_bytes image (bits->float) pass all 26 f32/f64 vectors incl. sNaN payloads, -0.0, subnormals, inf, in run/--debug/build/build --debug; ~15% slower than a memcpy shim. Recorded in docs/decisions/0002-float-bits.md.

title: Spike: exact-length stdin reads and stdout flush
description: os.read_stdin reads until EOF, which deadlocks the interactive conformance protocol (4-byte LE length + payload, response, flush, repeat). os.write_stdout/flush_stdout exist and stdout is unbuffered. Find a way to read exactly N bytes and detect clean EOF: likely an extern fn shim over read(2) in conformance/io.c with a testee.build sidecar.
acceptance_criteria: Echo program reads length-prefixed frames from stdin and writes them back, verified with a Python driver that interleaves writes and reads without closing stdin; clean EOF exits 0; short read exits nonzero; docs/decisions/0003-stdio.md records the mechanism.
close_reason: pbio_read_exact C shim over read(2) plus unbuffered write_stdout/flush_stdout; driver.py passes 10/10 under goose run, --debug, goose build and build --debug; decision in docs/decisions/0003-stdio.md

title: Spikes: Goose feasibility questions
description: Time-boxed experiments that answer Goose language questions before the phases that depend on them. Each spike ends with a written conclusion in docs/decisions/.
acceptance_criteria: Every child spike is closed with a merged decision record in docs/decisions/.

title: Phase 0: Plumbing
description: Toolchain, generator skeleton, conformance runner, hand-written testee, golden harness and CI wired end to end before any real generation.
acceptance_criteria: CI is green end to end on ubuntu and macOS: generator builds, golden harness runs, conformance runner runs the hand-written testee with the (empty) failure list.
close_reason: All 9 Phase 0 plumbing tasks closed.

title: pb_read_tag accepts tags longer than 5 bytes
description: Conformance Required.Proto3.ProtobufInput.BadTag_OverlongVarint: a tag 0x88 0x80x7 0x00 (field 1 varint, 9 bytes) parses. protobuf rejects a tag varint over 5 bytes (tags are 32-bit). pb_read_tag only checks the value.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime unit test: a 6-byte and a 9-byte encoding of tag 8 are PB_ERR_MALFORMED, a 5-byte one is accepted; BadTag_OverlongVarint passes in the conformance suite.
close_reason: pb_read_tag rejects tag varints over 5 bytes (test-first: 5-byte accepted, 6- and 9-byte malformed); BadTag_OverlongVarint passes (607 successes, 17 failures).

title: Extend reserved-name escaping to builtins and generated functions
description: Per docs/decisions/0006-naming.md: the emitter escapes only Goose keywords. Extend the reserved list to Goose builtins (reference §25), pb_-prefixed names, and names that would clash with generated functions/accessors (<M>_decode, _encode, _size_of, _clear, _set_<field>, _<field>_at/_get/_put, a nested name equal to a parent accessor). Claim every generated name (types, constants, functions) in the collision check.
design:
Two passes per file. Pass 1 claims every generated function/global name from unescaped paths: per message

_decode/_encode/_size_of/_clear/_copy,

_Ref/_pool/_links (0001), plus per-field accessors from one table (fieldAccessors): string/bytes ,set_; repeated ,_at,add_; map _get,_put; singular message ; explicit presence (message, proto3_optional, proto2 optional) has_,clear_; implicit scalars none. Pass 2 emits types/constants: reserved final names (keywords, builtins §25, pb_/PB_ prefix) get '_'; a nested type or enum constant whose name is claimed by a generated name gets '_' (once); top-level clash or still-claimed -> collision error. Function names are final names too, so they are escaped by the reserved rule (pb_x_decode -> pb_x_decode_).
acceptance_criteria: Goldens: a message with a nested message named decode, a field and nested message sharing a name, a message named str and one named pb_x all generate escaped names that pass goose check; an unresolvable clash is a response.error; Zig unit tests for the reserved list.
close_reason: Reserved list covers keywords, builtins (ref §25) and pb_/PB_ prefixes; all generated functions/globals/accessors are claimed first and nested clashes escape with '_'. Golden tests/protos/reserved.proto (nested decode/pool, accessor-named nested messages since protoc forbids a field and nested type with one name, str, pb_x, thread.spawn, enum constant vs setter) passes goose check; collision cases and the reserved list have Zig unit tests.

title: Pass all required proto3 binary tests
description: Fix remaining proto3 failures; remove entries from the failure list.
acceptance_criteria: No Required.Proto3.ProtobufInput.* entries left in the failure list; any remaining entries are Recommended.* with a bead each.

title: Switch testee envelope to generated bindings
description: conformance.proto needs oneof, string, enum and repeated messages (FailureSet), so the envelope can only be generated now. Replace the hand-parser in the testee.
acceptance_criteria: Testee contains no hand-written wire parsing; conformance results unchanged or better.

title: Round-trip Struct, Value, ListValue, FieldMask
description: The remaining WKTs need maps, oneofs and repeated fields; generate them natively (no unknown pass-through).
acceptance_criteria: Each generates, passes goose check and round-trips nested sample values byte-identically.

title: Emit map fields as entry messages
description: Maps encoded/decoded as repeated entry messages (key=1, value=2); missing key/value use defaults; duplicate keys: last wins; deterministic encode order (insertion).
acceptance_criteria: Conformance map tests pass for all key types and message values; roundtrip with duplicate keys keeps the last value.

title: Emit repeated message, string and bytes fields
description: Repeated length-delimited fields stored as runs per the layout; order preserved.
acceptance_criteria: Roundtrip with 0, 1 and many elements including empty strings/messages; conformance repeated tests pass.

title: Emit oneofs as fixed-mode ADTs
description: Real (non-synthetic) oneofs become fixed-mode ADTs with a none variant; last occurrence wins; message-typed members merge if the same member repeats.
acceptance_criteria: Golden for a oneof with scalar, string and message members; conformance oneof tests pass including merge cases.

title: Emit repeated scalar fields
description: Repeated numeric fields: decode both packed and unpacked forms regardless of declaration; encode packed for proto3 (and per-field packed option).
acceptance_criteria: Roundtrip: packed input, unpacked input and a mix of both decode to the same values; encode is packed; empty repeated field emits nothing.

title: Generate and round-trip well-known types
description: Generate google/protobuf/{any,timestamp,duration,wrappers,empty}.proto from the protoc include dir; fields not yet supported pass through as unknown. Decide where generated WKTs live (shipped with runtime vs generated by user).
acceptance_criteria: Each WKT generates, passes goose check and round-trips a sample value byte-identically; location decision recorded in docs/decisions/.

title: Shrink failure list after Phase 2
description: Regenerate the testee, rerun the suite, remove newly passing entries.
acceptance_criteria: Failure list strictly shorter than after Phase 1; no new entries; all sub-message/string/bytes tests that do not involve repeated/oneof/map pass.

title: Emit string and bytes fields
description: String and bytes fields stored per the layout; proto3 strings validated as UTF-8 on decode (reject overlong, surrogates, > U+10FFFF); validator in pb_wire.
acceptance_criteria: pb_wire UTF-8 tests cover valid multi-byte, overlong, surrogate, truncated sequences; conformance invalid-UTF-8 tests pass; roundtrip of empty, ASCII and multi-byte strings.

title: Emit singular sub-message fields
description: Encode/decode/size_of for singular message fields; presence is the handle; merge semantics: a repeated occurrence of a sub-message merges into the existing one (scalars last-wins, sub-messages recursively merged).
acceptance_criteria: Roundtrip and conformance merge tests (e.g. split sub-message across two occurrences) pass; golden for nested messages.

title: Support recursive messages with depth limit
description: Recursive message types need 'recursive fn' decoders/encoders; enforce a nesting depth limit (100, matching protobuf defaults) on decode.
acceptance_criteria: Self-recursive and mutually recursive messages generate and pass goose check; depth 100 decodes, depth 101 fails cleanly; no non-fixed locals held across the recursive call.

title: Enable proto3 binary tests and seed failure list
description: Run the suite, commit the current failures as conformance/failure_list_goose.txt (from here on it may only shrink).
acceptance_criteria: run_conformance.sh green with the seeded list; every scalar-only proto3 test passes (none of them in the list); count of listed failures recorded in the commit message.

title: Implement decode context and pool storage
description: Implement the layout chosen in the layout spike: a decode context owning reusable pools; messages as fixed-size records with handles to sub-messages, repeated runs, bytes and unknown fields. Update pb_wire and the generator's message emission accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: Existing Phase 1 goldens and roundtrip tests migrated and green; docs/decisions/0001 updated if the design changed; user-facing API documented in a comment in the generated file header.
notes: gpb-41j.6 already added pb_Span, pb_bytes, pb_run, pb_resize, pb_bytes_append/free/trim and pb_unknown_append to pb_wire (tests/runtime/pb_wire_pool_test.goose); records end in pb_unknown: pb_Span. This task adds M_pool/M_links and the typed run pools.

title: Use generated bindings in the testee
description: Generate TestAllTypesProto3 (and the well-known types it imports) via the plugin at build time; the testee decodes protobuf_payload into it and re-encodes. The request/response envelope stays hand-parsed until oneof/string support (Phase 3). Parse failures reply parse_error.
design: scripts/build_testee.sh [out]: zig build the plugin, protoc-generate google/protobuf/test_messages_proto3.proto, stage it flat in build/testee-src/ with testee.goose, io.c, testee.build and pb_wire.goose (flat, so one pb_wire), goose build -> build/testee. testee.goose: TestAllTypesProto3 binary in/out -> decode, encode, protobuf_payload (3); decode error -> parse_error (1); clear after. Other message types (proto2, editions) and non-binary formats stay skipped. run_conformance.sh builds the default testee through build_testee.sh. check_testee.py contract updated (roundtrip payload, parse_error, proto2 skipped).
acceptance_criteria: Testee builds from generated code; runner reports binary tests as run (not skipped) for TestAllTypesProto3; generation is part of the testee build script.
close_reason: scripts/build_testee.sh generates TestAllTypesProto3 with the plugin and builds the testee against it; run_conformance.sh uses it. Binary T3 requests are decoded/re-encoded (parse_error on failure); runner now reports 606 successes, 18 failures, 4942 skipped (proto2/editions/JSON/text). check_testee.py updated to the new contract and passes.

title: Emit has-bits for proto3 optional
description: Phase 0 advertises FEATURE_PROTO3_OPTIONAL, so proto3 'optional' scalars need explicit presence: a has-bits word per message, set on decode, emitted if set even when equal to the default. Synthetic oneofs must not become ADTs.
design: proto3 optional numeric/bool/enum fields are stored. Presence bit i lives in record field pb_has<i/32>: u32 (pb_ names are reserved, so no proto field can take it). Decode sets value and bit; encode/size_of test the bit, not the value, so a set 0 is encoded; M_clear zeroes the words. Accessors from the table: scalar with presence gets set_<f>, has_<f>, clear_<f> (set_ is needed because a direct write to m.f cannot set the bit). The synthetic oneof is ignored (no ADT); real oneofs and proto2 presence stay skipped. Golden + roundtrip tests/protos/optional.proto with 33 optional fields (two has-words).
acceptance_criteria: Roundtrip test: optional field set to 0 is encoded; unset field is not; decode sets the bit; golden shows no ADT for the synthetic oneof.
close_reason: proto3 optional numeric/bool/enum fields stored with has-bits (pb_has<k> words), set_/has_/clear_ accessors; encode/size_of test the bit so a set 0 is encoded, decode sets it, M_clear zeroes the words; synthetic oneofs produce no ADT. Golden + roundtrip tests/protos/optional.proto (33 presence fields, two words) match protoc --encode. Fixed present-false bool encoding as 1 (pb_bool_to_u64).

title: Preserve unknown fields on decode
description: Decode skips unknown field numbers (and wire-type mismatches) into the message's unknown-field storage; encode appends them. Field kinds not yet supported (messages, strings, repeated, maps, oneofs) are treated as unknown so whole test messages still round-trip.
acceptance_criteria: Roundtrip test: message with interleaved unknown varint/fixed/len/group fields re-encodes with all unknown bytes preserved; TestAllTypesProto3 generates and passes goose check.
close_reason: Unknown fields (and fields of kinds not stored yet, and wire-type mismatches) are appended raw to the record's pb_unknown run in pb_bytes during decode (in-pool doubling, trimmed at the end, recursion-safe), re-encoded after the known fields, counted in size_of, freed by clear. Roundtrip tests/roundtrip/unknown covers interleaved varint/I64/LEN/I32 fields from protoc, groups with nesting, mismatches, merging and errors. TestAllTypesProto3 generates and passes goose check with no warnings (scripts/check_generated.sh, in the CI conformance job).

title: Emit proto3 scalar fields
description: For all 15 scalar types: struct fields, encode (skip default values, implicit presence), size_of, decode (last value wins). Per-message encode/decode/size_of; uses pb_wire.
design: Scope: the 13 numeric/bool scalar types plus enums (i32), implicit presence only. string/bytes are gpb-8qn.4; proto3 optional (and real oneof members, groups, repeated, messages) are skipped on decode like unknown fields until their tasks (41j.5, 41j.6 storage, 8qn, gp4). Per message: record fields in declaration order; M_decode_from (tag chain, last value wins, unknown/mismatched wire type -> pb_skip_field), M_decode, M_encode and M_size_of in field-number order (matches protoc), skip zero (floats by bits, so -0.0 is emitted), M_clear resets fields. Tags precomputed as literals. Record-field names escaped with ident and checked for collisions. Roundtrip harness scripts/roundtrip.sh: tests/roundtrip/<name>/{<name>.proto, *.txtpb with '# proto-message:' header, <name>_test.goose}; protoc --encode each txtpb to .bin next to the generated code, test embeds the .bin files, checks decode->encode identity, field values, and that a Goose-built message encodes to the same bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Golden + roundtrip test (tests/roundtrip/) with a message holding every scalar type: encode→decode→encode is byte-identical; bytes match protoc --encode for the same text input; default values not emitted.
close_reason: 13 numeric/bool scalar types and enums stored with implicit presence: record fields, decode_from/decode (last value wins, unknown and mismatched wire types skipped), encode/size_of in field-number order skipping defaults (floats by bits, -0.0 encoded), clear. Golden tests/protos/scalars.proto; round-trip harness scripts/roundtrip.sh with tests/roundtrip/scalars (all set, extremes, explicit defaults -> 0 bytes, -0.0, skipped fields) matches protoc --encode byte for byte. string/bytes are gpb-8qn.4.

title: Implement skip_field and unknown-field copy
description: pb_wire: skip_field for wire types 0,1,2,5 and groups 3/4 with matching end-group field number and a nesting depth limit; copy of a skipped field's raw bytes into an unknown-field buffer.
acceptance_criteria: Tests: each wire type skipped correctly; mismatched end-group rejected; wire types 6/7 rejected; nested groups beyond the limit rejected; length overflowing the buffer rejected; copied bytes equal the input span.
close_reason: pb_wire: recursive pb_skip_field (varint, i64, len, i32; groups to matching end-group with depth shared with message nesting; stray end-group and wt 6/7 malformed) and pb_append_unknown (raw tag+value bytes). tests/runtime/pb_wire_skip_test.goose: each wire type, nested/empty groups, mismatched/lone end-group, wt 6/7, unterminated group, len past buffer and past window, truncated fixed, depth limit at 100/101 and combined with message depth, copied bytes == input span. Mutation of end-group check caught.

title: Build generator core and Goose emitter
description: Descriptor model over CodeGeneratorRequest (files, messages, nested types, enums, fields), Goose identifier mangling (keywords, case, nested names), one output .goose file per .proto, deterministic ordering, emitter helpers with indentation. Enums emitted as i32 constants (Goose enums have no discriminants). response.error for unsupported input, exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: Golden tests for an empty message, nested messages, enums with negative and aliased values, names colliding with Goose keywords; output passes goose check and is byte-deterministic.
close_reason: generator/src/emit.zig: one .goose per file_to_generate (dir/x.proto -> dir/x.goose), namespace from package (dots -> _), nested names joined with _, enums as i32 consts <Enum>_<VALUE>, keyword escaping by trailing _ on the final name, mangled-name collisions -> response.error with no files (exit 0); descriptor-order output. Goldens: empty, nested (3 levels), enums (negative, i32 min/max, aliases, nested), keywords (package/message/enum/value), smoke; all pass goose check and the double-generation determinism check. Zig unit tests 8/8. Indentation helper deferred to gpb-41j.4 (first indented output).

title: Implement pb_wire scalar primitives
description: runtime/pb_wire.goose: varint encode/decode on u64, zigzag32/64 (in u64), fixed32/64 LE, float/double bits per float spike, tag encode/decode, varint size. Error idiom per the error spike. Use as! for wrapping casts.
acceptance_criteria: tests/runtime/pb_wire_test.goose covers 0, 1, 127, 128, 16383, 16384, 2^63, 2^64-1; negative int32 encodes as 10 bytes; zigzag of i64 min/max; varint > 10 bytes and truncated input rejected; NaN/inf/-0.0 round-trip bit-exact; goose check passes; runs green in goose_tests.sh.
notes: Float bits: pure Goose per docs/decisions/0002-float-bits.md (bytes_of for float->bits; hand-built from_bytes image in a fixed u8[5]/u8[9] for bits->float). No C sidecar. Reuse the 26 vectors from tests/spikes/float_bits/pure.goose in unit tests.
close_reason: runtime/pb_wire.goose: pb_Reader + sticky errors (0004), varint read/write/size (u64, lenient 10th byte, 11th rejected), int32/int64 sign-extension helpers, zigzag32/64 in unsigned math, fixed32/64 LE, float/double bits (0002, pure Goose), tag read (rejects field 0, >2^29-1, wt 6/7)/write/size, pb_read_len. tests/runtime/pb_wire_test.goose covers all acceptance vectors incl. the 26 float vectors; green in goose_tests.sh; mutation of zigzag caught.

title: Spike: decode error propagation idiom
description: Options: trailing bool, optional result, 'return E from f' (long-distance return; currently may only carry references to globals/static data). Decode is recursive (recursive fn; no non-fixed locals live across the recursive call; non-fixed params must be references/slices). Choose the idiom generated decode functions use and check it composes with recursion and pools.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype recursive decoder with truncated-input and depth-exceeded errors compiles under 'goose check' and behaves under --debug; docs/decisions/0004-decode-errors.md fixes the generated signature for decode/encode/size_of.
close_reason: Chose sticky error code in a by-ref reader (docs/decisions/0004-decode-errors.md). Prototypes tests/spikes/decode_errors/{sticky,throw}.goose: recursive Node decoder with pool; truncated, depth, malformed varint, window overrun; goose check + run --debug pass. Sticky ~15-50% faster than exception::throw at -O2 and keeps pb_wire primitives callable without a try. Generated decode/decode_from/encode/size_of shapes fixed; storage params left to gpb-wof.1.

title: Spike: prototype message storage layout
description: Goose has no heap and NO root struct (only a design doc in v2026.3); pools are 'reusable var p: T[>..]' (alloc_index/alloc_ref/free) and 'reusable[] var' (alloc_slice/free_slice). A struct holds at most one resizable field, last. Prototype a decode context holding pools, with fixed-size message records referencing sub-messages, repeated runs, bytes and unknown fields by handle/index. Use a recursive message with repeated, map and bytes fields (e.g. a Node{name bytes; children repeated Node; attrs map<string,bytes>}). Measure ergonomics of the generated API from the user's side.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype under tests/spikes/layout/ builds with 'goose build --debug' and round-trips a hand-encoded 3-level message; docs/decisions/0001-message-layout.md states the chosen layout, the user-facing API sketch (construct, read, encode, decode), and rejected alternatives.
close_reason: Layout decided: fixed-size records + global reusable pools via pb_Span runs and wrapped pool-relative links, one slot per sub-message (docs/decisions/0001-message-layout.md). Prototype tests/spikes/layout/ builds with goose build --debug and round-trips a 3-level Node{name bytes, repeated Node children, map<string,bytes> attrs}; API sketch and rejected alternatives (context pools, slices in records, inline runs, flatbuffer arena, zero-copy) recorded. 0004 signatures made concrete.

title: Phase 3: Repeated, packed, oneof, maps
description: Repeated fields (packed and unpacked), oneofs as ADTs, maps as entry messages; testee envelope switched to generated conformance.proto.
acceptance_criteria: All required proto3 binary conformance tests pass; testee uses only generated bindings.

title: Phase 1: proto3 scalars
description: pb_wire runtime, generator core and proto3 scalar fields with implicit presence; unknown fields preserved; proto3 conformance tests enabled.
acceptance_criteria: Proto3 binary conformance runs with generated TestAllTypesProto3 bindings; failure list seeded and committed; all scalar-only tests pass.

title: Phase 2: Sub-messages, strings, bytes
description: Message storage layout from the layout spike, sub-messages with merge semantics, recursion with depth limit, strings with UTF-8 validation, bytes, well-known types.
acceptance_criteria: All proto3 binary tests touching sub-messages, strings, bytes and the scalar well-known types pass; failure list shrank.

title: Mangle output file names into importable Goose paths
description: Per docs/decisions/0006-naming.md: Goose import a.b.c maps to a/b/c.goose, so foo.v1.proto or my-api.proto would be unimportable. Map each path segment of the .proto name, with - and . replaced by _ and then escaped, to the output path (api/foo.v1.proto -> api/foo_v1.goose). Two protos mapping to the same output path are a collision error.
acceptance_criteria: Goldens for a dotted and a hyphenated proto name; a second generated file imports one of them and passes goose check; a mapping collision is a response.error with no files.

title: Emit M_copy deep copy for messages
description: Per docs/decisions/0001-message-layout.md, a record copy shares its pool contents (spans/links), so clearing one copy invalidates the other. Emit M_copy(dst: M&, src: M&) that deep-copies bytes runs, repeated runs, map entries and sub-message slots, recursively.
acceptance_criteria: Generated M_copy for a message with bytes, repeated, map and recursive sub-message fields; a roundtrip test clears the source after copying and the copy still encodes identically; goldens updated.

title: Add libFuzzer harness on generated C
description: Build generated decoders with 'goose -o x.c --standalone --header x.h --debug', link a libFuzzer entry point that decodes then re-encodes; corpus from conformance inputs.
acceptance_criteria: tests/fuzz/ harness builds with clang -fsanitize=fuzzer,address; runs 10 minutes without crashes locally; short smoke run in CI.

title: Add cross-implementation round-trip tests
description: tests/roundtrip/: encode with protoc --encode (and Python protobuf) → decode with generated Goose → re-encode → protoc --decode; and the reverse.
acceptance_criteria: Round trips for proto2, proto3 and editions sample messages pass in CI; mismatches print a hex diff.

title: Run editions conformance up to 2023
description: Generate TestAllTypesProto2/3 editions variants and TestAllTypesEdition2023 into the testee; run with --maximum_edition 2023.
acceptance_criteria: No Required.Editions*.ProtobufInput.* entries in the failure list; CI passes --maximum_edition 2023.

title: Drive emitters from resolved features
description: Replace syntax checks with resolved features: presence→has-bits, CLOSED→unknown-value handling, EXPANDED/PACKED, VERIFY/NONE utf8, DELIMITED→group encoding.
acceptance_criteria: Existing proto2/proto3 goldens unchanged; new editions goldens for each feature value.

title: Resolve edition features per element
description: Compute resolved FeatureSets for files, messages, fields and enums (defaults per edition + overrides): field_presence, enum_type, repeated_field_encoding, utf8_validation, message_encoding.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests against hand-written descriptors for each feature and inheritance level; matches protoc's resolution for the editions golden protos.

title: Enable proto2 binary tests
description: Generate TestAllTypesProto2 into the testee; handle it in the dispatch; shrink the failure list.
acceptance_criteria: No Required.Proto2.ProtobufInput.* entries in the failure list.

title: Advertise editions support
description: Set supported_features |= FEATURE_SUPPORTS_EDITIONS (2) and minimum_edition = EDITION_PROTO2, maximum_edition = EDITION_2023 (Edition enum values) in the response.
acceptance_criteria: protoc accepts an edition = "2023" file with the plugin; unit test checks the response fields.

title: Preserve extensions as unknown bytes
description: Extension ranges are not given typed accessors; extension fields round-trip as unknown fields.
acceptance_criteria: Conformance extension round-trip tests pass for TestAllTypesProto2; no generator crash on files declaring extensions.

title: Check required fields
description: Track required fields via has-bits; decode reports missing required fields as an error (configurable partial parse not needed for conformance).
acceptance_criteria: Missing-required decode fails; all-present succeeds; nested required checked.

title: Support groups
description: Group fields (wire types 3/4) encode/decode with matching end-group field numbers; reuse skip_field depth handling.
acceptance_criteria: Conformance group tests pass; roundtrip of nested groups; mismatched end group rejected.

title: Treat unknown closed-enum values as unknown fields
description: proto2 enums are closed: on decode an unknown value goes to unknown fields (singular, repeated, packed elements individually, map values drop the entry into unknowns).
acceptance_criteria: Conformance closed-enum tests pass; roundtrip preserves unknown enum values via unknown fields.

title: Emit explicit presence for proto2 fields
description: proto2 optional scalars use the has-bits from the proto3-optional task; encode when set, regardless of value.
acceptance_criteria: Roundtrip: set-to-default fields encoded; unset fields not; golden for a proto2 message.

title: Support proto2 default values
description: [default=...] for all scalar types, enums, strings and bytes (C-escaped), floats including inf/-inf/nan; getters return the default when unset.
acceptance_criteria: Golden + test for every default kind, including bytes escapes and nan; unset fields read as the default but are not encoded.

title: Spike: distribute pb_wire as a Goose package
description: Generated files import the runtime. Goose packages: import x from "owner/repo@tag"; fetched with git into ~/.goose/pkg; only the root file declares packages; local form "../dir". Decide how generated code imports pb_wire (package vs vendored copy vs local path) and what the repo layout must be for the package entry (name.goose).
acceptance_criteria: Sample consumer project outside the repo imports pb_wire via a local-path package and via a git URL (local bare repo is fine) and builds; docs/decisions/0005-runtime-distribution.md records the import form the generator emits and the release/tag procedure.

title: Phase 5: Editions
description: Advertise editions support and resolve per-element features onto the existing proto2/proto3 code paths.
acceptance_criteria: Conformance with --maximum_edition 2023 passes required binary tests for the editions test messages.

title: Cross-cutting: interop, fuzzing, docs
description: Quality work that spans phases: cross-implementation round trips, fuzzing, user documentation, hosting decision, recommended conformance tests.
acceptance_criteria: All children closed.

title: Phase 4: proto2
description: Explicit presence, defaults, closed enums, required fields, groups, extensions preserved as unknown bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Required proto2 binary conformance tests pass for TestAllTypesProto2; failure list shrank.

description: scripts/roundtrip.sh (gpb-41j.4) and scripts/check_generated.sh (gpb-41j.6) have no self-test, and golden.sh's fail-on-warning check (gpb-41j.6) is not covered by test_golden.sh. Add scripts/test_roundtrip.sh with fixtures under scripts/testdata/roundtrip/ (a passing case, a program that aborts, a txtpb without '# proto-message:', a missing proto), a check_generated fixture that warns, and a golden fixture that warns; wire them into the CI harness self-test step.

acceptance_criteria: CI job with --enforce_recommended passes against a separate recommended failure list that may only shrink.

description: docs/usage.md: installing the plugin, running protoc, importing the runtime package, constructing/encoding/decoding messages with the pool API, limitations (binary only).
acceptance_criteria: Every snippet is compiled by a CI script; reviewed against the runtime-distribution decision and the hosting decision.

title: Decide remote hosting and package path
description: No remote yet. Decide where the repo is hosted and the owner/repo path used in Goose package imports, CI badge and docs.
acceptance_criteria: Decision recorded in docs/decisions/; README, TOOLCHAIN.md and generator import path updated; remote added only after approval.

title: Port generator to Goose
description: generator-goose/: Goose implementation of the plugin over the generated bindings.
acceptance_criteria: Produces output for all golden protos; passes goose check.

description: CI step bootstrapping the Goose generator and diffing its output with the Zig generator on goldens and conformance protos.
